column1: A plain cylindrical bore with thrust that builds as the port opens up.|普通圆柱形内孔，随着燃烧通道扩大，推力逐渐增加。
A star with points that offset the opening bore for near-constant thrust.|星形内孔，星尖燃尽产生的变化抵消通道扩大的影响，使推力近乎恒定。
Deep spokes give a large initial burning surface that collapses as they burn out.|深辐条提供较大的初始燃烧面积，辐条燃尽后燃烧面积迅速减小。
Curved slots deliver a hard kick until their fins burn through, leaving a large low-thrust port.|弯曲槽道在薄片燃穿前提供强劲的初始推力，之后留下较大的通道，推力降低。
Short slots burn out early, then the thick remaining propellant builds thrust back up.|短槽较早燃尽，随后剩余的厚层推进剂使推力再次上升。
A dense propellant combination with modest performance; excellent for keeping the size of larger booster stages reasonable.|密度高、性能适中的推进剂组合，适合控制大型助推级的体积。
The pinnacle of chemical propellant performance, but requires very large propellant tanks; excellent for upper stages.|性能最高的化学推进剂组合，但需要非常大的推进剂贮箱，适合上面级。
Balances good performance with reasonable density, but both propellants are cryogenic.|兼顾较好的性能与适中的密度，但两种推进剂均需低温储存。
Low-performance but simple and cool-burning.|性能较低，但使用简单，燃烧温度也较低。
Low-performance, but is the only storable, benign bipropellant mixure.|性能较低，但它是唯一可长期储存且危害较小的双组元推进剂组合。
Storable hypergolic mixture favored for spacecraft engines and RCS.|可长期储存的自燃推进剂组合，常用于航天器发动机和反作用控制系统（RCS）。
Storable monopropellant that provides a benign alternative to hydrazine.|可长期储存的单组元推进剂，是危害较小的肼替代品。
The standard (but highly toxic) storable monopropellant for simple, reliable RCS.|标准的可储存单组元推进剂，适用于简单可靠的反作用控制系统（RCS），但毒性很强。
The highest-performance reaction mass by far, thanks to its very low molecular weight.|由于分子量极低，其推进工质性能远高于其他选择。

Hydrogen taken far past dissociation into a fully ionised plasma, where each atom carries a free electron and the mean particle mass halves. Only a confined fusion core reaches these temperatures.|氢在解离后进一步完全电离，形成由自由电子和离子组成的等离子体，平均粒子质量降至原子状态的一半。只有受约束的聚变核心才能达到这种温度。
Dense and benign reaction mass, but low performance due to its very high molecular weight.|密度高、危害较小的推进工质，但分子量很高，因此性能较低。
A denser reaction mass than hydrogen, trading performance for storability.|比氢密度更高的推进工质，以牺牲性能换取更容易储存。
Storable and dense reaction mass with moderate performance.|可长期储存、密度高且性能适中的推进工质。
A very poor-performance reaction mass, but extremely abundant.|性能很低的推进工质，但资源极其丰富。
Inert and dense reaction mass; simple but low-performance.|惰性且密度高的推进工质，使用简单，但性能较低。
High-thrust storable solid propellant; the natural choice for large solid rocket motors.|可长期储存的高推力固体推进剂，适合大型固体火箭发动机。
Lower-performance solid propellant than APCP, but easier to manufacture; burns consistently and cleanly.|性能低于高氯酸铵复合推进剂（APCP），但更容易制造，燃烧稳定且洁净。
An inert monatomic gas; its light weight and total non-reactivity make it the standard tank pressurant.|惰性单原子气体，质量轻且几乎不参与反应，是标准的贮箱增压气体。
The lightest fuel, giving the highest exhaust velocity, but its deep cryogenic storage and low density are costly.|最轻的燃料，可提供最高的排气速度，但深低温储存和低密度会带来较高成本。

Hydrogen made of antiparticles. It annihilates with ordinary matter, turning all of its mass into energy, so a few tonnes drive a starship. Only a magnetic trap tank can hold it.|由反粒子组成的氢，与普通物质湮灭时将全部质量转化为能量，几吨即可驱动星际飞船。只能使用磁阱贮箱储存。
A cheap, inert gas for pressurization and cold-gas thrusters where helium's low mass isn't worth the cost.|廉价的惰性气体，适用于增压和冷气推进器，可在氦的轻质量优势不足以抵消成本时使用。
The standard oxidizer: high-performance and non-toxic, though it must be kept cryogenic.|标准氧化剂，性能高且无毒，但必须低温储存。
Vital for life support, abundantly available, may be used as reaction mass in a pinch.|生命保障所必需，资源丰富，必要时也可用作推进工质。
A dense, cheap noble gas for cold-gas or electric thrusters where storage density beats efficiency.|密度高、价格低的稀有气体，适用于储存密度比效率更重要的冷气或电推进器。
A cheaper, denser alternative to xenon for ion thrusters, trading some efficiency for cost.|离子推进器中氙的替代品，价格更低、密度更高，以降低部分效率换取成本优势。
The premier ion-thruster propellant - dense and easily ionized - but rare and expensive.|优良的离子推进剂，密度高且易于电离，但稀有而昂贵。
A flammable combustion by-product; rarely chosen deliberately, but a usable in-situ fuel.|可燃的燃烧副产物，很少被主动选作燃料，但可作为就地获取的燃料使用。
Dense, inert, and easily gathered in-situ, making it a convenient if low-performance reaction mass.|密度高、性质稳定且容易就地获取，是方便但性能较低的推进工质。
A dense, clean-burning cryogen that resists coking and can be made in-situ.|密度高、燃烧洁净且不易结焦的低温燃料，可以就地生产。
Storable and hydrogen-rich, a compromise reaction mass when cryogenic hydrogen is impractical.|可长期储存且富含氢，当低温氢难以使用时，是一种折中的推进工质。
A dense, cheap, room-temperature fuel that keeps stages compact, at the cost modest performance.|密度高、廉价且可在常温下储存的燃料，可缩小火箭级体积，但性能适中。
Storable and usable as a catalytic monopropellant, though highly toxic.|可长期储存，并可通过催化分解用作单组元推进剂，但毒性很强。
A storable (but highly toxic) hypergolic fuel that ignites on contact with its oxidizer, favored for reliable spacecraft engines and RCS.|可长期储存但毒性很强的自燃燃料，与氧化剂接触即点燃，常用于需要高可靠性的航天器发动机和反作用控制系统（RCS）。
The standard storable oxidizer, igniting hypergolically with hydrazine fuels; toxic and corrosive.|标准的可储存氧化剂，与肼类燃料接触即自燃，具有毒性和腐蚀性。
A cheap, easily handled fuel that burns cool enough to spare chamber walls, at the cost of modest performance.|廉价且易于处理的燃料，燃烧温度较低，可减轻燃烧室壁的热负担，但性能适中。
Extremely concentrated hydrogen peroxide; a storable oxidizer and monopropellant that is less toxic than hydrazine.|极高浓度的过氧化氢，可作为可储存氧化剂和单组元推进剂，毒性低于肼。

Felsic volcanic glass.|长英质火山玻璃。
